feeds.title: Village House » Interior Design
feeds.description: Looking for ways to spruce up your apartment in Japan? Village House is your source for practical and cost-effective interior design tips for your Japanese apartment. We bring you tips, guides, and recommendations on what to buy and where to buy it. Let us help you make your apartment feel like home.

feeds.title: Shotenkenchiku Blog
feeds.description: Shotenkenchiku is the only magazine that has been dedicated to Japanese store design and commercial architecture since 1956. The magazine offers readers the very latest interior designs of restaurants, hotels, fashion stores, hair salons, etc with many pictures, detailed floor plans, and information on main materials. It is considered to be a must-read for architects, interior designers.

feeds.title: ADF Web Magazine
feeds.description: ADF was established in 2009, as a nonprofit organization(NPO), with the aim of contributing to the improvement of education and culture related to design by building a wide range of networks with domestic and international organizations and citizens through the collection of various information related to design and information dissemination.

feeds.title: Casereal News
feeds.description: Led by designer Koichi Futatsumata, CASE-REAL works on interior / architecture projects.With creative ideas and technological studies based on each environment, objective and tasks given for each project CASE-REAL will seek for an essential solution to fit each atmosphere.

feeds.title: Azabu Interior Blog
feeds.description: Azabu Interior delivers authentic Western lifestyles. Since its establishment in 1969, with many years of experience and achievements, we have provided embassies, furniture and services for expatriates to live comfortably at reasonable prices.

feeds.title: Kubo Tsushima Architects
feeds.description: A Tokyo architectural design office by young architect Hideo Kubo + Yumi Miyakojima. We design a wide range of hotels, super public baths, hot bath facilities, saunas, beauty treatment salons, wealthy housing, stores, post offices, inns, offices, restaurants, wedding halls, chapels, etc. all over the country.

feeds.title: Voiger Blog
feeds.description: Voiger is the official blog website of the Japanese interior designer Hajime Yoshimoto. Through this blog, he shares the latest ideas and tips on interior design and provides inspiration to people.

feeds.title: Dezeen » Japan
feeds.description: Stories about architecture and design in Japan, including Japanese houses, apartments and stores, and news related to the country. Dezeen is the world's most popular and influential architecture, interiors, and design magazine.
